description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Work directly with business customers to deploy and configure AI-driven software in production environments. Own customer rollouts from scoping through delivery, and bring field learnings back to the engineering team to strengthen the core platform. Act as the technical partner to the commercial team throughout the sales and expansion process.
 What you'll do
 - Embed with customers to understand their existing processes and identify where automation adds the most value.
 - Deploy and configure AI agents against customer systems, including data source connections, single sign-on and other integrations.
 - Build evaluation suites using real customer data to verify quality before release, and iterate until quality targets are met.
 - Partner with the go-to-market team to close, activate and expand accounts as the technical authority.
 - Feed field insights back into the core product and fix platform limitations when they get in the way.
 - Debug live deployments and perform root cause analysis when agents behave unexpectedly in production.
 - Own the smallest end-to-end slice that demonstrates value, then expand from there.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM-based agents with customers, including prompts, evaluations and long-running workflows.
 - Customer-facing technical deployment or implementation experience, owning rollouts rather than only building the platform.
 - Strong Python skills with FastAPI for backend work and React for frontend work.
 - Experience at a high-growth startup in an early-stage, zero-to-one setting.
 - For junior candidates, a degree from a strong computer science program.
 - Lives in the Bay Area already or is ready to move there to work in a hybrid setup.
 Bonus points
 - A career path that moved from a large technology employer into startups.
 - Prior experience as a founder or founding engineer at an early-stage company.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 180,000 to 230,000 per year
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - SF Bay Area, CA, United States (also San Francisco and Los Angeles, CA)
 - Hybrid
 - Full-time
